title: Estoquista
description:
Descrição da vaga

Na Inbrands, nosso universo é feito de marcas icônicas e pessoas protagonistas que acreditam na colaboração para impulsionar resultados.

Estamos em busca de um(a)
Estoquista
, alguém organizado(a), proativo(a) e atento(a) aos detalhes, para apoiar a operação da loja, gerenciar o estoque de forma eficiente e garantir que os produtos estejam sempre disponíveis para oferecer a melhor experiência aos clientes.

Somos líderes e agimos como donos. Temos um imenso orgulho de tudo o que fazemos e um enorme prazer em cada realização. Executamos de forma simples, onde sempre prevalece o melhor argumento e a melhor ideia na gestão de moda.

Em nosso portfólio estão Bobstore, Ellus, Richards, Salinas, VR Collezioni e Tommy Hilfiger. Nossas marcas são consideradas icônicas e estão posicionadas como marcas premium com distribuição através de lojas próprias, franquias, multimarcas e e-commerce.

Se você gosta de moda, de um ambiente descontraído, dinâmico e cheio de desafios vem para Inbrands

Lembramos que nossas oportunidades são para todos. Na Inbrands, você encontra um ambiente diverso, com respeito e empatia.
Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Receber, conferir e organizar produtos no estoque da loja;
  • Garantir o correto armazenamento e conservação dos produtos;
  • Controlar entradas e saídas de mercadorias, registrando movimentações em sistemas de gestão;
  • Apoiar a equipe de vendas com reposição de produtos nas lojas;
  • Auxiliar na contagem de inventário e na prevenção de perdas;
  • Zelar pela organização, limpeza e segurança do estoque;
  • Colaborar com a equipe para garantir que todos os produtos estejam disponíveis para venda;
  • Seguir procedimentos internos, normas de segurança e padrões da Inbrands.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Experiência anterior em funções de estoque ou logística;
  • Conhecimento básico em controle de estoque e sistemas de gestão (ERP ou PDV);
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Proatividade e comprometimento com prazos e processos;
  • Conhecimento em rotinas de inventário, conferência e armazenamento de produtos;
  • Facilidade para operar ferramentas de registro de entrada e saída de produtos;
  • Vivência no segmento de varejo, moda ou lifestyle será considerada um diferencial;
  • Disponibilidade para horários flexíveis e atuação em escala de loja.

Informações adicionais

Assistência médica com contratação de dependentes, após 90 dias;

Flexibilidade para você escolher entre vale refeição ou vale alimentação;

Assistência Odontológica, após 90 dias da contratação;

Para quem está sempre buscando novos conhecimentos, contamos com parcerias nas melhores faculdades;

Ama descontinhos? oferecemos descontos nas marcas do grupo (conforme política);

Seguro de vida 100% custeado pela empresa, afinal valorizamos a segurança;

Day after de aniversário, será um dia todinho de folga para você aproveitar como quiser;

Total Pass para você que gosta de cuidar da sua saúde, nada melhor que parceria com as melhores academias.

Nossa História

Quem Somos
Somos movimento, criatividade e história. A Inbrands nasceu em 2008 com um propósito claro: construir um ecossistema de marcas que inspiram pessoas e transformam a moda em experiência.

Reunimos em nosso portfólio nomes que atravessam gerações e estilos como Ellus, Richards, VR, Salinas e Tommy Hilfiger – marcas que vestem personalidade, atitude e autenticidade.

Não seguimos tendências. Criamos caminhos. Evoluímos com consistência, estratégia e muito trabalho. Somos apaixonados por construir marcas fortes e negócios sustentáveis, sempre com foco no desenvolvimento das pessoas que fazem tudo acontecer.

Nosso DNA
Acreditamos que a moda vai além do vestir — ela conecta histórias, expressa identidades e cria relações verdadeiras.

Nosso propósito é inspirar pessoas através da moda e da experiência de marca, com integridade, atitude e paixão por fazer acontecer. Crescemos valorizando aquilo que nunca sai de moda: gente, essência e verdade.

Nossos Valores

title: Accreditation Documentation
description:
Accreditation Documentation & Training Materials Manager

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil


Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.
Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Accreditation programme requires clear, consistent, and accurate documentation and training materials to support staff, volunteers, and stakeholders across all venues and operational environments.
The Accreditation Documentation & Training Material Manager plays a central operational role in coordinating, developing, and delivering accreditation documentation and training content that supports consistent accreditation delivery throughout the tournament lifecycle.
Reporting to the FIFA27 Accreditation Senior Manager / Project Lead, the Accreditation Documentation & Training Materials Manager is responsible for the coordination, development, and delivery of accreditation documentation and training materials in support of tournament operations.
Working within established FIFA accreditation policies and frameworks, and in close collaboration with FIFA Zurich Accreditation, Accreditation Operations, Client Group Management, Systems, Security, and Venue teams, the role ensures that accreditation information and training materials are accurate, up‑to‑date, and accessible to all relevant audiences.
This role focuses on content coordination, operational enablement, and quality assurance. 
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Accreditation Documentation & Content Management:
  • Coordinate the development and maintenance of accreditation documentation for multiple audiences, including management, accreditation staff, volunteers, and external stakeholders.
  • Support the production of accreditation guidelines, manuals, process documents, and instructional materials.
  • Ensure all documentation aligns with approved FIFA accreditation policies, procedures, and terminology.
  • Coordinate reviews, updates, and version control of accreditation materials throughout the project lifecycle.
Training Material Development & Delivery:
  • Coordinate the development and delivery of accreditation training materials across multiple formats (e.g. presentations, instructional videos, train‑the‑trainer content, digital learning tools).
  • Identify the most appropriate media and formats to support different training needs and stakeholder groups.
  • Support the planning and implementation of accreditation training programmes in coordination with Accreditation Operations, Systems and Client Group Management.
  • Review and refine training materials based on feedback from events and tournament operations.
Operational Support & Cross‑Functional Coordination: 
  • Support centralised issue resolution processes by ensuring relevant accreditation guidance and reference materials are available and current.
  • Work across Accreditation workstreams to support operational deliverables where documentation or training inputs are required.
  • Support information sharing across workstreams to ensure consistent understanding of accreditation processes and updates.
Quality Assurance & Compliance:
  • Ensure accuracy, clarity, and consistency of all accreditation documentation and training materials.
  • Support compliance with data protection, access control, and accreditation governance requirements.
  • Ensure changes to processes or procedures are clearly communicated and reflected across all documentation.

YOUR PROFILE

  • University degree or equivalent in Event Management, Sports Administration, Operations, or a related field.
  • Minimum 4+ years of experience in accreditation, event operations, training, documentation, or related roles within major events.
  • Experience working with accreditation or access control systems is an advantage.
  • Experience working in fast‑paced, multicultural environments.
  • Strong organisational and coordination skills.
  • Excellent written communication and technical documentation skills.
  • Experience developing training and instructional materials.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and common collaboration and content creation tools.
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

description:
Accreditation Client Group Manager

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil


Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.
Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Accreditation Client Group Manager plays a key role in the operational delivery of client group accreditation services in support of tournament operations across all venues and official facilities.
Reporting to the Accreditation Client Group Senior Manager, the Accreditation Client Group Manager is responsible for the day-to-day coordination, and delivery of accreditation services for assigned client groups for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027. 
Working within the established tournament accreditation framework, and in close collaboration with FIFA Zurich Accreditation, FIFA27 Accreditation teams and functional areas, the role ensures that client group accreditation requirements are delivered in line with defined FIFA accreditation policies, access control protocols, and agreed service standards.
The role provides operational leadership to Client Group Coordinators and serves as the primary operational escalation point for assigned client groups.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Client Group Management:
  • Act as the primary accreditation point of contact for assigned client groups (e.g. safety & security, workforce, volunteers, suppliers, commercial partners).
  • Understand and manage client group accreditation requirements, volumes, timelines, and access needs in line with the overall accreditation framework and agreed milestones.
  • Coordinate the delivery of client group accreditation activities across all planning and operational phases.
  • Monitor readiness and proactively identify delivery risks, escalating issues as required.
Accreditation Process Delivery:
  • Manage the end‑to‑end accreditation process for assigned client groups, including data collection, validation, access rights assignment, badge production, and distribution.
  • Ensure accurate application of access rights in accordance with approved zoning concepts, access matrices, and security requirements.
  • Coordinate accreditation activities and dependencies with Accreditation Operations, Systems, Security, and Venue teams.
  •  Track application progress, volumes, and bottlenecks and implement corrective actions where required.
Team Leadership & Support:
  • Lead, coordinate, and support Client Group Coordinators in the delivery of day‑to‑day accreditation activities.
  • Provide guidance on complex cases and ensure consistent application of processes across client groups.
  • Support onboarding, training, and knowledge sharing within the client group team.
  • Promote clear task ownership, prioritisation, and accountability.
Stakeholder Engagement & Communication:
  • Work closely with FIFA and FIFA27 functional areas to support agreed accreditation requirements and timelines.
  • Communicate accreditation procedures, deadlines, and data requirements clearly and consistently to client groups.
  •  Support the preparation and delivery of training sessions, briefings, and guidance materials.
  • Act as the primary operational escalation point for client group accreditation issues, escalating complex or cross‑functional matters to the Client Group Senior Manager.
Event-Time Operations:
  • Support the operation of Accreditation Centres and badge distribution points before and during the tournament.
  • Coordinate with Venue Operations, Security, and Accreditation Operations teams to resolve access‑related issues quickly and effectively.
  • Provide operational decision‑making support within defined authority during peak arrival and match‑day phases.

description:
Who Are We?

Our Vision

Our goal is to create the largest and most influential DeFi ecosystem the world has ever seen, starting with becoming the gold standard in DeFi education. This vision is ambitious, transformative, and poised to change the landscape of digital finance.

Are You Ready?

This is more than just a job; it's an opportunity to shape the future of Web3 technology and education. Are you ready to be part of our vision to redefine what's possible in DeFi and beyond? Apply below, and let's explore this journey together.

Check us out here:Decentralized Masters

What will you be doing?

We are hiring a detail-oriented and proactive Virtual Assistant to take full ownership of our newsletter support inbox. This role is critical in ensuring subscribers receive timely, accurate, and professional responses—helping prevent negative reviews, reduce friction, and protect the DM brand as we scale.

The ideal candidate is highly organised, calm under pressure, and comfortable handling high volumes of inbound queries while maintaining a friendly, customer-first tone.

Key Responsibilities
  • Monitor and manage the newsletter support inbox daily
  • Respond promptly and professionally to subscriber inquiries related to:
    • Newsletter access and delivery issues
    • Subscriptions, opt-ins, and opt-outs
    • Technical or platform-related questions
    • General clarification requests related to newsletter content
  • Follow established SOPs and response guidelines to ensure consistency
  • Escalate complex or sensitive issues to the relevant internal teams when required
  • Tag, categorise, and track recurring issues to identify trends and improvement opportunities
  • Maintain accurate records of subscriber interactions
  • Support the creation and updating of FAQs and canned responses
  • Ensure response time SLAs are consistently met


PLEASE SUBMIT RESUME IN ENGLISH

What will you bring?

Must Have:

  • Native English speaker (or at least professional level)
  • Previous experience as a Virtual Assistant, Customer Support Agent, or Inbox Manager
  • Strong written English communication skills (clear, professional, and empathetic)
  • High attention to detail and excellent organisational skills
  • Ability to handle repetitive tasks without compromising quality
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth remote environment
  • Tech-savvy and able to quickly learn new tools and platforms
  • Reliable internet connection and ability to work independently

    • Nice to Have:

    • Experience supporting newsletters, email campaigns, or digital products
    • Familiarity with CRM, helpdesk, or ticketing systems
    • Exposure to online education, SaaS, or crypto/DeFi environments
    What Success Looks Like
    • Inbox is consistently cleared within SLA
    • Subscribers feel heard, supported, and valued
    • Minimal negative feedback or reviews related to newsletter support
    • Clear reporting on common issues and suggested improvements

    What do we offer?

    • Full time
    • Unlimited PTO
    • Team off-sites

title: Analista de Planejamento
description:
A Stone:


Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no(a) cliente.

Nascemos com o propósito de ser protagonistas na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, servindo o(a) empreendedor(a) brasileiro(a) e transformando seus sonhos em resultados.

Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país,  em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa RAZÃO.

Nossa Cultura: 


Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

 Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio. 

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.  

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos. 

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso. 

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos gerar impacto para nosso(a) cliente, quando enxergamos a melhoria que causamos na vida dele(a), é que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega. 

 


O time do Renda Extra - Ton:


Nosso propósito é suportar o canal de vendas dos nossos consultores TON. Nosso programa Renda Extra é um programa de indicação onde tanto os nossos clientes podem indicar novos clientes, assim como nossos consultores que usam o canal como principal fonte de renda. Além disso, buscamos fidelizar e aumentar a produtividade de nossos parceiros disponibilizando ferramentas, garantindo uma experiência gamificada e integrada. Somos o principal canal de novos clientes do Ton, e é o nosso papel potencializá-lo através de comunicação, planos de engajamento e projetos que ajudem a tornar a jornada do parceiro no programa mais longeva e valorosa.

 

Como é ser um(a) Analista de Planejamento SR:


Terá a missão de analisar e acompanhar os resultados do time do Renda Extra, identificando os principais desvios e traçando planos de ação para recuperação. Será responsável por criar relatórios e dashboards, assegurando que os dados estejam corretos e atualizados em parceria com o(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados. Também deverá propor melhorias e inovações para a área, tendo uma visão estratégica do negócio, propondo ações de melhoria, traçando plano e acompanhando com os principais stakeholders.

Principais responsabilidades: 

  • Acompanhar os resultados gerenciais e operacionais;
  • Criar, manter e atualizar dashboards e relatórios que suportem a tomada de decisão diária;
  • Garantir a precisão dos dados em conjunto com o Engenheiro de Dados, realizando conferências e validações;
  • Analisar tendências e propor ações de melhoria no desempenho do canal de Renda Extra;
  • Desenvolver novos dashboards quando necessário;Dar suporte ao Analista Gerencial em estudos estratégicos e metas relacionadas ao canal;

O que esperamos de você: 

  • Conhecimento avançado de Excel e/ou Google Sheets;
  • Conhecimentos Intermediário/Avançado de SQL e Python para extrair e manipular dados;

title: Senior Software Engineer I, Integrations
description:
The Company You'll Join


Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta's platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta's Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don't work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta's software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it's a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital. 

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.


The Problems You'll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. Most of Carta's long-term success will come from products and technology that have yet to be built. Here is an incomplete list of how you might contribute:

  • Building customer-facing enterprise tools for equity administration
  • Creating data pipelines for asynchronously aggregating financial reports
  • Reinforcing service resiliency, availability, and fault tolerance
  • Streamlining the creation of new features and services within our ecosystem
  • Integrating with third-party vendors to provide reliable, accurate, and timely transfers of billions of dollars per year through Carta's platform
  • Refactoring existing features into standalone event-driven services
  • And others for you to discover and champion

You'll work directly with internal and external stakeholders to ensure we're building the right thing at the right time with the right people. Your contributions will enable Carta's mission to make equity more available and accessible to everyone.

The Team You'll Work With

This role sits on our Data Integrations team, building the necessary network infrastructure for the flow of financial and HRIS (Human Resources Information Systems) data into and out of Carta, powering the entire company management experience. 

You will join our engineering team of passionate learners, builders, experts, and leaders to define and implement Carta's next generation of products, platforms, and infrastructure. You'll collaborate closely with key stakeholders in Product, Business, and Design. Carta's software engineers contribute in many different ways: sometimes we are shipping new product features, architecting simple and maintainable systems, or training the organization on new technology solutions. You will make your own mark here.

About You

At Carta, you're not just an employee. You're a builder who is creating  infrastructure that accelerates innovation and empowers more ownership. Cartans are helpful, relentless, unconventional and kind; representing Carta's Identity Traits. They work collaboratively and cross functionally  to challenge the status quo; working towards a common goal of creating more owners in the private markets.

  • You have 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer.
  • You have strong technical skills and are an excellent collaborator.
  • You implement systems that are clear, maintainable, and correct.
  • You are excited by opportunities to both break ground on new projects and provide fresh perspective onto past implementations.
  • You want to build and own your work end-to-end
  • You are eager to move fast, but recognize when to build for the future.
  • You have full stack experience, specifically with Typescript and any backend language
  • You may be familiar with some additional elements of the Carta tech stack (Python, Django, React,  Postgres, GRPC, Kafka, docker, K8, AWS)

The Interview Process

First, one of our recruiters will call you to tell you more about the job and company. You'll then meet an Engineering leader who will discuss your opportunities at Carta and explore your experience, skills, and goals. We'll then ask you to show off your skills with a real-world take home exercise (we do not do LeetCode-style interviews, no one will quiz you on writing a doubly-linked list). Finally, you'll have  back-to-back conversations with Carta team members on a wide range of topics, including communications and collaboration, coding efficacy and techniques, and systems design.

title: Analista De Pricing Senior
description:
Há mais de 29 anos, o Grupo CET LOGISTICS está presente no Comércio Exterior tendo iniciado suas atividades no segmento de Óleo e Gás, especializando-se em grandes projetos e, atualmente, é especializado também em logística integrada e internacional em transporte de mercadorias multimodal, presente nas áreas comerciais mais importantes do mundo.

O Grupo está envolvido em projetos globais para as mais diversas indústrias, desenvolvendo serviços porta a porta que incluem: coleta de carga em sua origem, planejamento estratégico, distribuição, rastreamento, expedição e desembaraço aduaneiro.

Nos últimos anos, a CET expandiu significativamente sua área de especialização, com grande knowhow e uma excelente reputação no mercado, oferecendo a seus clientes soluções personalizadas em toda a cadeia logística, com qualidade, agilidade, responsabilidade e transparência. Nossos escritórios e hubs estão situados no Rio de Janeiro/Brasil, Houston/EUA , Aberdeen (Reino Unido) e Roterdã/Holanda.

Hoje a CET atende sua base de clientes com mais de 250 especialistas em logística presentes em diferentes regiões do globo.

Conheça mais sobre a CET LOGISTICS e todos os nossos serviços no site:

Descrição de atividades:

· Elaborar propostas comerciais e cálculos de frete para clientes estratégicos, baseando-se em análises de custo, capacidade operacional e viabilidade econômica;

· Desenvolver, manter e aprimorar ferramentas de simulação de preços e margens, garantindo maior agilidade e assertividade na formação de preços;

· Realizar análises comparativas de mercado (benchmarking) e estudos de sensibilidade para embasar decisões de revisão de tabelas tarifárias;

· Acompanhar indicadores de rentabilidade por cliente, rota e tipo de serviço, propondo ajustes quando necessário;

· Suportar o time comercial em negociações, fornecendo análises de impacto financeiro e cenários alternativos de pricing;

· Trabalhar em conjunto com áreas como Operações, Financeiro, Fiscal e TI para garantir que os preços estejam aderentes aos custos e regras tributárias;

· Avaliar contratos existentes e sugerir revisões com base em performance, reajustes e desvios de rentabilidade;

· Identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos de precificação e implantação de práticas de pricing dinâmico, sempre que possível;

· Liderar projetos de reestruturação de pricing ou análise de novos modelos de negócio.

Competências:

· Pensamento crítico: questiona, analisa e recalcula;

· Comunicação clara e firme: sabe traduzir planilha para quem vive na estrada;

· Agilidade e organização: lida com prazos apertados, mas entrega com exatidão;

· Influência e negociação: sabe dizer "não" com fundamento e apresentar alternativas viáveis;

title: Dynamics 365 CE Senior Technical Architect
description:
Our client's Microsoft Business Solutions team is a Microsoft Gold Partner and leader in Microsoft software implementations for medium to large organisations, providing their clients with the ability to keep up with the ever-changing digital world by implementing Microsoft's Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and Customer Engagement (CE) software from the Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) software line.

Role Overview

The Dynamics CE & Power Platform Senior Technical Architect is a core team member of our client's customer delivery of Microsoft Dynamics 365 centred solutions. The STA will be involved in the business processes and solution design and will be hands on configuring and customising the implementation of Dynamics CE & Power Platform solutions working with both onshore and offshore development teams. The position may require business travel.

Job Location: Silema, Malta

Work Type: Hybrid

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Working Hours: GMT +1

Salary: Base + Benefits (Paid in Euros €)

Relocation: VISA & Relocation Package Included

Requirements

  • A University graduate with relevant degree within a computing or business discipline;
  • Microsoft Dynamics CRM Certifications (2016, D365) AND/OR Power Platform Certifications are desirable;
  • Strong technical & functional knowledge and understanding of Microsoft Dynamics CRM and/or Power Platform technology stack covering a wide spectrum of industries and sectors;
  • Minimum 12+ years of proven experience in IT which includes end to end implementation experience in either of Dynamics CRM / Power Platform solutions;
  • Strong and proven experience in developing solutions that involve Power Platform (including Power Apps like Canvas, Model driven etc., Power Automate, Power BI etc.);
  • Strong understanding of all areas within Customer Engagement including Sales, Marketing, Customer Service, Field Services, and Project Service;
  • Good understanding of Dataverse including customisations and development of Business Data Models for different solutions etc.;
  • Good understand of Microsoft Dynamics CRM Accelerators, industry templates and add-ons;
  • Proven track record of successful maintenance or end to end implementation of a number of solutions for medium/ large customers, preferably across a number of business verticals (e.g. healthcare, finance, insurance etc.);
  • Proven ability to develop a clear understanding of clients' needs and the ability to incorporate them into a solution following effective design approach;
  • Experience of consultancy roles in software delivery;
  • Experience in a delivery-orientated IT environment using waterfall, agile and DevOps methodologies;
  • Adept at business requirement analysis, solution design, development, system verification and deployment strategies;
  • Ability to see the bigger picture and suggest solutions both within and outside the current implementation;
  • Experience in creation of demos, supporting pre-sales activities is an advantage;
  • Business process mapping, Fit Gap analysis, work package estimation, work breakdown structure, modelling and documentation knowledge;
  • Excellent understanding of Dynamics CRM DB Schema and Business Data Model including the customisation and development of Business Data Models for different solutions;
  • Broad understanding of software development lifecycle, development management, release management, data migrations, cut-over planning and hypercare support;
  • Knowledge of Azure DevOps & CI/CD is a plus;
  • Knowledge and understanding of .NET framework including extensive experience writing ASP.NET and C# code (not just limited to plugins/custom workflows) is a plus;

Responsibilities

The CE Senior Technical Architect will work with the Consulting Services department to implement various modules of D365 CE (including Power Platform) working closely with client teams and business stakeholders.

  • Organise, execute, manage and document workshops, meetings and requirements sessions with the client representatives, project stakeholders, business analysts and consulting team;
  • Interface effectively with other members of the consulting team to arrive at best in class solution, and provide a sustainable and scalable solution architecture and application to meet client's requirements;
  • Deliver high quality business and software solutions & services to clients ensuring the implementation of best practices based on Microsoft Dynamics standards and supported configuration/ customizations;
  • Ensure completeness in meeting business requirements and take accountability for project deliverables including and not limited to project documentation, solution design, performance, reliability, testing features etc;
  • Deliver all consultancy and configuration work according to our project methodology, ensuring that all software applications are implemented successfully according to the SLA: on time and on budget;
  • Maximize usage of OOB features and provide technical design or develop/customize solution approach for identified gaps;
  • Contribute to activities as required including technical presales, building demo and proof of concept solutions for various client presentations. Proactively skilling up on new versions and technology stack to be future ready;
  • Work on the creation of Dynamics 365 solutions and industry templates;
  • Meet and exceed customer expectations of business knowledge, skills and behaviour;
  • Be a trusted advisor for our clients and help to provide solutions which can be upgrade ready;
  • Proactively identify business/ project/ technical/ support risks and provide suggestions to mitigate or communicate as necessary;
  • Proactively communicate progress updates to relevant parties both formally and informally;
  • Support practice development activities such as defining, solutioning and configuring industry specific solutions;
  • Be an active member of technical and design working groups within the practice;
  • In all activities, ensure timely completion of internal processes and mandatory trainings;
  • Drive for process improvement, feature reusability and other initiatives to maximize efficiency in delivery;
  • Carry out additional duties as may occur from time to time as instructed and agreed by the management team or supervisors;
  • Provide guidance and mentorship (technical/professional) to groom other team members;
  • Represent our client's Microsoft Business Solutions team in a professional and positive manner at all times;
  • A portion of the role also requires supporting and doing people management, people development & career progression support, performance assessment and management;
  • The Employee is required to follow our client's Information Security Policies (ISP and ISMP) at all times;

Microsoft Business Solutions Overview

At our client, your long-term future is every bit as important to them as it is to you. That's why our clients aim is to give you experiences that will stay with you for a lifetime. Whether it's great training and development, mobility opportunities or corporate responsibility volunteering activities – you'll gain a wealth of experiences on which to build a rewarding career. Our client is a firm that encourages you to be yourself, values your contribution, and inspires you to act as a role model, always focused on doing the right thing for each other, our clients, and our communities.

This sets out all the different ways you'll be rewarded at our client. Among other things, you can benefit from honest conversations about your career as well as a range of other rewards. In all these ways and more, they have created an environment that can bring out the best in you.

#Bethechange and #makethechange. Join our talented, successful team and make the leap into the future.

title: Network Solution Architect
description:
1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications leader, built to help enterprises unlock the full potential of mobile connectivity at scale. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform – including our own owned and operated global mobile core network, a full end-to-end eSIM technology stack, and an extensive portfolio of telecom licenses – 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider across 40 countries worldwide. Combined with our privileged access to the global wholesale telecom market, this positions us uniquely to deliver seamless, compliant, and scalable connectivity solutions anywhere in the world.  

We serve many of the world's leading banks, enterprises, and digital-first businesses, including neo-banks, fast moving consumer goods companies, travel leaders, and payment service providers. Today, 1GLOBAL connects more than 70 million people and devices globally, enabling our customers to launch, scale, and innovate with confidence in the mobile ecosystem.  

1GLOBAL is a profitable, fast-growing business. With full-year revenues exceeding US$200 million and profits of over US$25 million, we generate strong cash flows and fund our growth independently—continuously investing in infrastructure, platform innovation, and global expansion. Recent years have marked a defining phase in our journey, with major enterprise and mass-consumer client wins accelerating our evolution into a global mobile connectivity powerhouse, purpose-built to enable consumer brands to enter and succeed with their own telecommunications offerings.  

Founded in 2022 by experienced technology entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL has rapidly emerged as a European technology leader shaping the future of global telecommunications. We operate as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) in 12 countries and as a regulated telecom operator in an additional 28 markets. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, our team of close to 500 experts across 15 countries is united by a single ambition: to redefine global mobile connectivity through technology, scale, and execution excellence. 
Position Overview

As an Architect inside the Network Engineering department, you will act as a Solution Architect for new products, services and technologies in 1Global, acting as a point of contact towards internal and external customers. Effectively work closely with Product and Marketing, but also with all different technical stakeholders and vendors, in shaping, designing, testing, and implementing new solutions. The Architect is responsible for leading the requirements analysis process, in close contact with all relevant stakeholders, to a refined and clear scope, allowing a solution to be created, documented and planned to be implemented.
We are open to hiring for this position in São Paulo, Brazil. The successfully hired candidate will receive onboarding and training in Lisbon, gaining valuable skills while experiencing one of Europe's most dynamic and renowned cities.
Fluency in English is essential for this role. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English as part of your application.


Key Responsibilities

  • Iterates with the customer (internal and external) and other stakeholders to determine the technical requirements, risks, technical impacts, and recommendations
  • Design of new consumer and corporate telecom solutions
  • Collaborates with technical teams in defining reliable, modular, scalable, and customer-centric solutions, as well as planning and reviewing solutions
  • Design and present solutions in documents and workshops. For the solution identifies the impacts, efforts and the resources needed
  • Market prospection of new solutions through elaboration and analysis of Request for Information/Proposal/Quotation processes and negotiation with potential suppliers
  • Follow up of new technology trends in the Telecom industry and identifying interesting solutions for the product portfolio
  • Definition and follow up of company technological evolution roadmaps
  • Documents the existing technology portfolio and proposes recommendations for improvements and / or alternatives
  • Ensure and control quality of documentation execution (HLD's, LLD's, WO's, etc.)
  • Ensure and control implementation quality. Understanding of End to End system testing requirements
  • Ensure the network is compliant with industry standards and regulations
  • Capacity and Performance Analysis, Reporting and Improvement Solution Definition
  • Work on complex solutions that influence the design of current products and addresses design issues for future products or technologies. Enhance, simplify, and optimize existing applications and processes
  • Evolves the engineering maturity to be on par with the non-functional and functional state-of-the-art
  • Communicates transparently to the whole business
  • Reaches out to other teams and works towards alignment and overall continuous improvement

Requirements

Must Have

  • Excellent understanding of Mobile Networks and its architectures
  • Experience with MVNO architecture(s) and landscape. Familiar with roaming environment, including its technical, commercial and regulatory aspects
  • Solid knowledge of networking principles & protocols, including security
  • Experience in network protocols like MAP, CAMEL, SIGTRAN, DIAMETER, SIP
  • Knowledge and experience of OCS and Gy/Sy interfaces
  • Experience with VoLTE and VoWiFi
  • Experience with LTE, 5G, IMS, IP technologies and protocols
  • Familiar with cloud-based solutions and virtualization technologies
  • High Level Designs and Low Level Designs. Experience developing and presenting internal and external documents
  • Experience with 5G Core Mobile Networks
  • Experience with monitoring tools and protocols in Mobile Networks
  • Anticipates problems and addresses them before they cause impact
  • Understands how big-picture goals inform technical details and vice-versa
  • Ability to work in complex environments (multi-cultural/multi-country/geographically distributed teams)
  • High attention to detail. Doesn't leave things to be addressed or left undone
  • Business oriented, capable to engage and discuss with non technical persons in order to create technical requirements
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • English proficiency mandatory, other languages are a plus
  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience


Nice to Have

  • Experience with cloud applications monitoring and analytics is a plus
  • Experience with AI/ML cloud based service assurance is a plus
  • Extensive working experience on telecoms, designing and implementing mobile core networks

Benefits

What we offer?

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Extended parental leave - 180 days of maternity leave and 20 days of paternity leave.
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.


1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

title: Interpretation Geophysicist
description:
Viridien ) is an advanced technology, digital and Earth data company that pushes the boundaries of science for a more prosperous and sustainable future. With our ingenuity, drive and deep curiosity we discover new insights, innovations, and solutions that efficiently and responsibly resolve complex natural resource, digital, energy transition and infrastructure challenges.

Job Summary

We are looking for passionate geoscientists to join our Interpretation Team at Viridien. In this role, you will contribute directly to Velocity Model Building (VMB) by performing seismic interpretation and providing essential geological support to Processing and VMB teams.

From picking horizons to building velocity scenarios, you will work at the intersection of geology, geophysics, and advanced imaging tools, helping to transform complex seismic data into meaningful insights. Your work will play a critical role in delivering high-quality results to our clients and shaping decisions across energy and earth-data projects.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Perform seismic interpretation for VMB, including horizon picking (unconformities, salt horizons, pre-salt);
  • Create local velocity scenarios;
  • Apply imaging tools, workflows, and data QC (attributes, velocities, maps);
  • Integrate geological and geophysical data for deeper insights;
  • Engage directly with clients to present results and understand their perspectives.

About the Team:

You will join a diverse group of interpreters, geologists, and geophysicists who collaborate closely with Processing and VMB teams. Together, we tackle complex challenges, share knowledge, and drive innovation in seismic imaging. At Viridien, collaboration is key — you will be encouraged to bring your ideas forward and grow in a supportive environment.

Qualifications:

  • Master's or PhD in Geophysics, Geology, or related field; or equivalent professional experience in the Oil & Gas industry.
  • Solid background in seismic interpretation, exploration geology, stratigraphy, or basin analysis.
  • Strong geophysical knowledge (seismic attributes, AVO, reservoir characterization, quantitative interpretation, well data QC/processing).
  • Ability to integrate data across scales (well, seismic, potential data).
  • Good understanding of seismic imaging and prospect assessment.
  • Experience with Pre-Salt or Brazilian Equatorial Margin is a plus.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
  • Effective communication and presentation skills in English.
  • Python programming is a plus.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary with performance-based bonus.
  • Relocation package (when applicable).
  • Comprehensive health and dental insurance.
  • Private Pension Plan
  • Meal Voucher
  • Free breakfast and snacks at the office.
  • Shiatsu Therapy at the Office
  • TotalPass Fitness Program
  • Hybrid Work Model (up to 2 remote days per week)
  • Birthday Day Off
  • Christmas Gift Card
  • Educational Assistance and Language Learning Programs
  • Continuous training via the Learning Hub, with both technical and behavioral courses.

Our Hiring Process

At Viridien, we are committed to delivering a respectful, inclusive, and transparent recruitment experience.

Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we may not be able to provide individual feedback to every applicant. Only candidates whose qualifications closely match the role criteria will be contacted for an interview. We do, however, aim to share personalized feedback with those who progress to the first round of interviews and beyond.

We are also dedicated to ensuring that our hiring process accessible to all. If you require any reasonable adjustments to fully participate in the application or interview stages, please don't hesitate to contact your recruiter directly.

We see things differently. Diversity fuels our innovation, we value the unique ways in which we differ, and we are committed to equal employment opportunities for all professionals.

title: Drilling Engineer
description:
The Drilling Engineer will support BWE Brazil's Drilling & Completion (D&C) team on Brazilian assets. This position will manage directional planning databases and coordinate interfaces between engineering, operations, logistics, and subsurface teams.

Responsabilities:

  • Specifically work with the D&C Well Delivery Team on the Maromba development phase I drilling campaign.
  • Ensure compliance with Company and Drilling & Completion policies, standards and approved procedures.
  • Manage Maromba wells directional planning database plus survey database.
  • Drafting and owning project Directional Surveying Policy.
  • Manage the interfaces between engineering, operations, logistics and subsurface during all phases of the well/project.
  • Liaison and management of daily interface between D&C and all stakeholders.
  • Support drilling engineering projects for Brazilian assets.
  • Work with the Well Delivery Team on Maromba Phase I drilling campaign.
  • Manage directional planning and survey databases (Compass).
  • Draft and maintain the project's Directional Surveying Policy.
  • Perform torque, drag, and hydraulics analysis using industry software for program optimization.
  • Assist in well planning, design, engineering, costing, and operational execution.
  • Prepare scopes of work for tenders, evaluate vendors, and draft award recommendations.
  • Ensure Well Barrier Schematics are current and valid.
  • Maintain campaign performance database (TvD curves, NPT records, KPIs).
  • Coordinate After Action Reviews (AAR) and Lessons Learned database.
  • Engage and manage service companies to ensure safe and efficient delivery.
  • Participate in risk assessments, DWOP/CWOP, and pre-job planning meetings.
Requirements

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering.

Experience:

  • 6–8 years in drilling engineering with operators or service companies in Brazil.
  • Experience in multi-well development projects with directional/horizontal wells.
  • Proficiency in Landmark tools (Wellplan, StressCheck, Compass) or equivalents.
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken).
  • Valid IWCF Level 4 certification preferred.

title: Auxiliar de Turma
description:
O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 121 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.

Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.

Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

SOBRE A VAGA
A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo e em pensar as melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos.

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Neste papel você será responsável pelos cuidados com os alunos de Infantil e pelo apoio em outras atividades de Operações. Deve ser uma pessoa proativa, afetuosa, cuidadosa, cordial, que possui facilidade em se comunicar e se relacionar com crianças pequenas e que é capaz de lidar com o ambiente dinâmico de uma escola (esta é uma vaga temporária de licença maternidade).

RESPONSABILIDADES
O que você fará:

  • Acompanhar e cuidar da boa convivência entre os alunos;
  • Auxiliar o time na rotina dentro de sala;
  • Acompanhar o almoço, escovação de dentes e demais rotinas do aluno do Ensino Infantil;
  • Realizar a entrada e a saída dos alunos;
  • Organizar as salas e demais espaços;
  • Apoiar com organização e operação de eventos escolares;
  • Organizar as mochilas dos alunos;
  • Trocar a roupa dos alunos antes das atividades extras;
  • Higienizar materiais de artes (aventais, pincéis e outros);
  • Atuar em conformidade com os valores, orientações e procedimentos estabelecidos pela escola.

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.
REQUISITOS
O que você precisa ter:

  • Ensino Médio Completo;
  • Experiência em cuidados com crianças.

Nossos auxiliares de turma devem ser capazes de/devem ter:

  • Estar sempre em busca de melhorias;
  • Atitude positiva frente a mudanças;
  • Preocupação e atenção genuína pelos níveis mais altos de bem-estar dos alunos.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Experiência prévia em escolas.

DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA
O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação.

Visit our careers site for more information;

title: Engenheiro(a) de Software
description:
Sobre a área:
A tecnologia tem desempenhado um papel fundamental nas grandes transformações do banco BTG Pactual. Para isso, investimos no que há de mais moderno no mercado. Nosso time é responsável pelo desenvolvimento doFinest,sistema que atende a área de Finance na frente offshore. Somos focados na entrega eficiente e robusta de funcionalidades. Todos desenvolvem, testam e discutem soluções para problemas tanto de negócio quanto de código.

Nosso time adota metodologia ágil e possui profundo conhecimento de mercado e design de software. Somos uma equipe meritocrática e versátil. Valorizamos profissionais commentalidade de dono, que sonham grande e são apaixonados por aprender e ensinar.

No seu dia a dia:

  • Promover a automatização e otimização de processos e análises;
  • Garantir a alta disponibilidade das plataformas, criando e evoluindo processos dedeploy;
  • Desenvolver software seguindo metodologias ágeis e aplicandoboaspráticas de programaçãoaplicando conceitos dosolid, designpatterns ecleancode;
  • Criar algoritmos, KPIs e modelos para alavancar as operações doBanco;
  • Estabelecer um relacionamento próximo com as áreas de negócio e outras equipes deIT do grupo.

Esperamos de você:

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia, Ciências da Computação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Interesse em aprender e trabalhar com boas práticas de desenvolvimento de software: designpatterns,code review, cleancode;
  • Interesse em aprender sobre mercado financeiro;
  • Experiência,ou vontade de trabalhar,com as seguintes tecnologias: .NET Core/Framework, C#,angular, Python, AI,Kubernetes, cloud AWS como AWS EC2, AWS S3, AWSLakeFormation, AWSGlue,AWS Lambda,SNS/SQS, Kafka MQ,RabbitMQe PostgreSQL;
  • Nível avançado ou fluente em inglês;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar no modelo híbrido nos escritórios doRio de Janeiro ouSão Paulo.

Benefícios:

  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR);
  • Auxílio Alimentação e Refeição;
  • Plano Médico;
  • Plano Odontológico;
  • Auxílio Creche/Babá;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • WellHub;
  • TotalPass;
  • Programa de Apoio Pessoal (EAP);
  • Planos por adesão como Previdência Privada e Seguro de Vida;
  • Desconto em Farmácia;
  • Programa de Nutrição;
  • Programa de Gestantes;
  • Licença Maternidade e Paternidade Estendida – empresa Cidadã.

title: Consultor de Governaça de Dados
description:
Quais serão suas responsabilidades?

  • Implantar e evoluir a área de Governança de Dados, considerando pessoas, processos e tecnologia.
  • Definir e implementar o framework de Governança baseado no DAMA-DMBOK, incluindo domínios, políticas, princípios e padrões.
  • Estruturar modelo organizacional e RACI (Data Owner, Data Steward, Data Custodian, etc.).
  • Criar e manter políticas de dados, normas, diretrizes e processos de governança.
  • Definir e implantar glossário de dados, taxonomias e catálogos corporativos.
  • Atuar na definição de qualidade de dados, métricas, indicadores e processos de monitoramento.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de LGPD e compliance, em conjunto com áreas jurídicas e de segurança.
  • Conduzir workshops, treinamentos e ações de change management para disseminação da cultura data-driven.
  • Atuar como elo entre áreas de negócio, TI, arquitetura, analytics e segurança da informação.

O que é necessário para participar desse processo seletivo?

  • Sólido conhecimento do DAMA-DMBOK e seus domínios (Governança, Qualidade, Metadados, MDM, Segurança, Arquitetura de Dados, etc.).
  • Experiência prática em implantação de Governança de Dados, não apenas conceitual.
  • Conhecimento em Data Management, Data Quality, Data Catalog, Data Lineage e Metadata Management.
  • Vivência com ferramentas de governança e catálogo (ex.: Collibra, Alation, Purview, Informatica, Ataccama, ou similares).
  • Noções de arquitetura de dados (Data Lake, Data Warehouse, BI, Analytics).
  • Experiencia comprovada com cloud Azure, Unit Catalog (Databricks) e Power BI.
  • Conhecimento em LGPD, privacidade e proteção de dados.

Perfil Comportamental

  • Visão estratégica aliada à capacidade de execução.
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade de traduzir conceitos técnicos para o negócio.
  • Capacidade de articulação com stakeholders executivos e operacionais.
  • Perfil consultivo, analítico e orientado a resultados.
  • Autonomia, organização e capacidade de conduzir frentes paralelas.

Diferenciais - Desejável

  • Certificações em DAMA/CDMP, Governança de Dados ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos complexos e regulados.
  • Atuação prévia em projetos de transformação digital ou data-driven.

Por que fazer parte do time DBC Company?

  • Somos a 13ª melhor empresa para trabalhar do Brasil e a 2ª melhor empresa para trabalhar no Rio Grande do Sul, segundo o GPTW 2025;
  • Todos os profissionais que estão alocados em clientes e/ou projetos são acompanhados por Gestor da DBC e também por Business Partner;
  • A DBC incentiva seus colaboradores a obterem certificações relacionadas à sua área de atuação e alinhadas com sua Gestão DBC.

O que é importante saber?

  • Nosso time promove um ambiente seguro para todos os profissionais independente de sua etnia, crença religiosa, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência, idade, etc.

Somos a Americanas, uma das maiores varejistas do país, com mais de 95 anos de história. resolver a vida das pessoas

Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias; valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. A Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Estamos construindo a cada dia uma cultura com base no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência. Todas as nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas com base nesse princípio.

title: Support Analyst, Corporations
description:
The Company You'll Join


Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta's platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta's Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don't work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta's software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it's a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital. 

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

**Please submit resumes in English**


The Problems You'll Solve 


At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. 

As our customers' primary point of contact, support analysts will address inbound requests/inquiries over phone, chat and email. A successful candidate will be comfortable and confident in written and verbal communication with whichever of Carta's stakeholders they end up working with. This could include C-level executives, customers' employees, law firms (partners and paralegals), as well as investors/board members. 

As a support analyst, the responsibilities and duties you can expect include:

  • Provide timely and accurate front-line support for all customers that your support segment services
  • Proactively follow-up with your clients and stay actively engaged from the day a case is opened 
  • Engage with clients real-time via phone or zoom
  • Keep documentation of client interactions so that you and your teammates can identify and address trends through process improvement
  • Become an expert in our security and escalation practices
  • Train your clients based on the understanding you have acquired while working with them

The Team You'll Work With


Our team's mission is to provide excellent customer service by leveraging our knowledge of equity and Carta to reduce customer effort and empower clients to efficiently manage their ownership. 

As a Support Analyst, you will have the opportunity to support one of product lines including: Cap Table Management, Carta Partner Program, Carta for LLCs, Launch and Carta Total Compensation.  

About You

  • Fluent in English with strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail as our work is subject to many legal regulations
  • Care deeply, genuinely, and passionately about client services 
  • Excited to take on new challenges
  • Ability to articulate technical and complex concepts in a clear and concise manner
  • Ability to balance multiple active projects
  • Exhibit diplomacy, tact, and poise when communicating with clients or customers
  • Driven to help and solve problems
  • Experience in a fast paced, client facing environment is a plus 
  • Experience learning new technologies, platforms, and systems is a plus

Even if you don't have all of the qualifications we've listed, please apply if you believe you could be impactful in this role

title: Analista de Dados e Inteligência de Mercado
description:
Nós somos amantes do oceano. Somos uma empresa brasileira que há mais de 45 anos desenvolve soluções submarinas para o mercado de energia offshore, garantindo a sustentabilidade dos oceanos. E se você compartilha essa paixão pelo mar e também é comprometido com a proteção do meio ambiente e seus valiosos recursos, seu lugar é aqui na Oceânica Venha fazer parte da nossa família

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Desenvolver, implementar e manter soluções robustas de relatórios e painéis de controle (Dashboards) automatizados e dinâmicos para visualização de dados de gastos (Spend Analysis), desempenho de fornecedores e KPIs de Suprimentos.
  • Conduzir a arquitetura, design, e validação de dados e relatórios, assegurando a consistência e a credibilidade das informações de performance de Suprimentos.
  • Preparar e consolidar dados para a entrega de apresentações executivas e relatórios periódicos para a liderança e stakeholders.
  • Monitorar o mercado, fornecedores e as tendências tecnológicas de Suprimentos, transformando informações complexas em estratégias claras e roadmaps.
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria e inovação dentro de grandes conjuntos de dados (internos e externos), suportando decisões estratégicas de negócios e categorias de compras.
  • Desenvolver modelos de simulação, ferramentas e templates para apoiar a Gestão de Performance de Suprimentos e mitigar riscos.
  • Atuar na coordenação de atividades de melhoria contínua (E2E) ao longo de todo o sub-processo Source-to-Contract, identificando oportunidades de transformação alinhadas à estratégia.
  • Desenvolver e apoiar o desenvolvimento de ferramentas customizadas em parceria com áreas usuárias, adotando soluções de Source-to-Contract para Tech Enablement.
  • Capacitar os clientes internos (Buyers, Gerentes de Categoria) para que sejam autônomos na gestão e análise de suas informações, diminuindo a dependência do time de Excelência.

Requisitos e qualificações

Mandatório:

  • Ensino Superior em Engenharia, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou Administração.
  • Mínimo de 4 anos de experiência na função ou áreas correlatas.
  • Proficiência em Excel (fórmulas, Tabelas Dinâmicas, Power Query).
  • Domínio de Ferramentas de Visualização de Dados (Business Intelligence), como Power BI ou Tableau.
  • Conhecimento em Linguagens de Programação e Consulta (ex: SQL, Python ou R) é um diferencial forte.
  • Experiência com Sistemas de Suprimentos (Source-to-Pay), como SAP Ariba, Coupa ou similares.
  • Conhecimento em Metodologias de Gestão de Projetos (PMI, Scrum, Lean).
  • Inglês avançado.
  • Análise de Dados e Estatística Aplicada.
  • Modelagem e Engenharia de Dados.
  • Conhecimento de Ferramentas e Processos de Procurement.
  • Análise de Custos e Financeira (Business Understanding).

Desejável:

  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Data Science, Business Intelligence, ou áreas correlatas.

Informações adicionais

Vale transporte;Vale alimentação ou refeição;Plano de saúde extensivo aos dependentes legais;Plano odontológico extensivo aos dependentes legais;Seguro de vida;Gympass;Curso de Inglês.

Com mais de 45 anos de história e mais de 2.300 colaboradores engajados e altamente capacitados, somos uma empresa brasileira líder no desenvolvimento de soluções submarinas para a indústria de energia offshore.

Atuamos na prevenção, contingenciamento e engenharia, oferecendo soluções completas e inovadoras. Hoje, Contamos com quatro bases: Rio de Janeiro, Niterói, Macaé (RJ) e Rio das Ostras (RJ), além de projetos espalhados por toda a costa brasileira.

Estamos em crescimento constante e buscamos pessoas que compartilhem nossa paixão e queiram fazer parte dessa jornada transformadora. Aqui, você encontrará um ambiente dinâmico, com oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento e um compromisso contínuo com a segurança, a inovação e a sustentabilidade.

Somos uma empresa apaixonada pelo mar e comprometida com a preservação ambiental.

Por que se juntar à Oceânica?

  • Inovação em foco: Nosso Centro de Inovação desenvolve soluções pioneiras e customizadas para desafios subaquáticos.
  • Operações integradas e de excelência: Contamos com um dos centros operacionais mais avançados do mundo, integrando tecnologias de Mergulho, ROV e Posicionamento Dinâmico.
  • Treinamento contínuo: Nosso Centro de Treinamento de Mergulho é referência em atualização e aprimoramento, garantindo o melhor preparo para nossos profissionais.
  • Impacto real: Atuamos com responsabilidade ambiental e social, entregando soluções que preservam o oceano e tornam o mundo mais limpo.

Se você é movido pela inovação, pelo desejo de crescer e pela vontade de fazer a diferença, a Oceânica é o lugar certo para você. Estamos prontos para construir um futuro ainda mais sustentável e cheio de conquistas. E você, está pronto para mergulhar nessa com a gente?

As an Intern in the International Controllership team, you will have the opportunity to gain hands-on experience in financial operations across multiple countries. Your responsibilities will include:

The International Controllership team of VTEX is responsible for preparing IFRS accounting and managing local GAAP accounting of all the VTEX entities outside Brazil; local audits in some countries; and improving processes that may impact the VTEX financial statements.

The Retention Marketing Specialist owns the day-to-day execution of email and SMS production for our clients. You will manage end-to-end production and keep timelines on track across design, strategy, and client teams. You will manage the full production process for email campaigns and automated flows, build emails in Klaviyo or similar ESPs, write on-brand copy, create clear briefs for the design team, QA content and logic, and schedule deployments. You will maintain the monthly content calendar, drive timelines with clients, and ensure all assets and approvals stay on track. You will support the Retention Marketing Strategist by pulling performance data, analyzing results, and developing recommendations. You will build automated workflows, segmentation, and list logic, maintain list hygiene, and work confidently with Shopify apps such as Yotpo, Loyalty Lion, JustUno, and Privy.

Based on our projected customer base growth, we foresee the need for a  Retention Marketing Specialist  within the next 2-4 months to ensure we can effectively manage and nurture our expanding user community.

  • 2 years of experience in retention marketing, specifically across email, SMS, CRM, or loyalty programs.
  • Hands-on experience with an Email Service Platform (ESP), with a strong preference for Klaviyo.
  • Strong copywriting skills for direct-to-consumer (DTC) e-commerce, with the ability to adapt tone and style to match different client brands.
  • A solid understanding of email analytics and the ability to translate data insights into actionable strategy.
  • Clear understanding of the difference between marketing campaigns and automated flows, and knowing when to deploy each.

description:
DESCRIÇÃO
Quer trabalhar na maior empresa de bikes elétricas do Brasil?

Nascemos em 2010, no Rio de Janeiro.

A nossa missão desde então é fazer com que as pessoas reflitam sobre os seus hábitos.

E não apenas os hábitos relacionados à mobilidade urbana.

Queremos que as pessoas olhem mais ao seu redor.

Como você leva a sua vida?

Qual é a sua relação com a natureza, com o tempo, com o seu trabalho, família e amigos?

A nossa marca não é apenas sobre bicicletas elétricas.

A Lev é sobre escolhas, como escolher o caminho mais bonito em vez do mais rápido.

E por falar em caminho, que ele seja sempre a melhor parte.

Muito prazer, nós somos a Lev.

title: Accreditation Documentation
description:
Description


FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION


The Accreditation programme requires clear, consistent, and accurate documentation and training materials to support staff, volunteers, and stakeholders across all venues and operational environments.

The Accreditation Documentation & Training Material Manager plays a central operational role in coordinating, developing, and delivering accreditation documentation and training content that supports consistent accreditation delivery throughout the tournament lifecycle.

Reporting to the FIFA27 Accreditation Senior Manager / Project Lead, the Accreditation Documentation & Training Materials Manager is responsible for the coordination, development, and delivery of accreditation documentation and training materials in support of tournament operations.

Working within established FIFA accreditation policies and frameworks, and in close collaboration with FIFA Zurich Accreditation, Accreditation Operations, Client Group Management, Systems, Security, and Venue teams, the role ensures that accreditation information and training materials are accurate, up‑to‑date, and accessible to all relevant audiences.

This role focuses on content coordination, operational enablement, and quality assurance.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Accreditation Documentation & Content Management:

  • Coordinate the development and maintenance of accreditation documentation for multiple audiences, including management, accreditation staff, volunteers, and external stakeholders.
  • Support the production of accreditation guidelines, manuals, process documents, and instructional materials.
  • Ensure all documentation aligns with approved FIFA accreditation policies, procedures, and terminology.
  • Coordinate reviews, updates, and version control of accreditation materials throughout the project lifecycle.

Training Material Development & Delivery:

  • Coordinate the development and delivery of accreditation training materials across multiple formats (e.g. presentations, instructional videos, train‑the‑trainer content, digital learning tools).
  • Identify the most appropriate media and formats to support different training needs and stakeholder groups.
  • Support the planning and implementation of accreditation training programmes in coordination with Accreditation Operations, Systems and Client Group Management.
  • Review and refine training materials based on feedback from events and tournament operations.

Operational Support & Cross‑Functional Coordination:

  • Support centralised issue resolution processes by ensuring relevant accreditation guidance and reference materials are available and current.
  • Work across Accreditation workstreams to support operational deliverables where documentation or training inputs are required.
  • Support information sharing across workstreams to ensure consistent understanding of accreditation processes and updates.

Quality Assurance & Compliance:

  • Ensure accuracy, clarity, and consistency of all accreditation documentation and training materials.
  • Support compliance with data protection, access control, and accreditation governance requirements.
  • Ensure changes to processes or procedures are clearly communicated and reflected across all documentation.

YOUR PROFILE

  • University degree or equivalent in Event Management, Sports Administration, Operations, or a related field.
  • Minimum 4+ years of experience in accreditation, event operations, training, documentation, or related roles within major events.
  • Experience working with accreditation or access control systems is an advantage.
  • Experience working in fast‑paced, multicultural environments.
  • Strong organisational and coordination skills.
  • Excellent written communication and technical documentation skills.
  • Experience developing training and instructional materials.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and common collaboration and content creation tools.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women's World Cup 2027


The FIFA Women's World Cup is the greatest women's sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women's football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we're looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women's football.
